## VS Evolution Helper (BepInEx) 1.8.1

### Highlights
- **Controller / keyboard Stage Guide:** LB/RB (or Q/E / PageUp/Down) switch Music|Guide
- Tabs are UI Buttons (focus + Submit/A)
- Vertical stick / arrows scroll Guide content
- Guide relic icons are selectable; controller dwell shows tooltips

### Install
1. **BepInEx 6 IL2CPP** only (not MelonLoader)
2. Extract zip so you get `BepInEx/plugins/VSEvolutionHelper/VSEvolutionHelper.dll`
3. Close the game before updating the DLL
